title: Calibration event payload (W5)
description: One observer's result on one calibration exercise, computed by rules.calibration_pass. Shares only: the observer's scores and the reference scores never enter the event log.

signoff_id.description: The observer's scoring sign-off the result was computed from

inter_observer.description: Optional, additive within major 1: this observer's agreement with the other observers of the exercise, pooled over them (spec W5 step 2, against each other). Reported only: passed is decided against the reference alone.
